name: openLanguageSettings
description: Open Chrome's native languages settings page (chrome://settings/languages) in a normal (non-kNexus) browser window. Trusted, fixed internal URL opened via window_util::OpenUrlInNormalWindow — does NOT go through openUrl (which rejects chrome:// for untrusted conversation links). Backs the React Settings - General 'Open language settings' button; Chrome owns the language list + restart-to-apply flow.
